title: A function of the game's code (registry/functions/<scope>/<Name>.json)
description: What we have understood of one function, keyed by its id; where it is in each build is in builds/. Our own words, never code of the game. registry/README.md.

does.description: Our sentence: what the function does.

piece_of.description: For a piece the compiler made (a thunk, a part split off, a copy for one caller): the function it is a piece of.

returns.description: The return type as C++ writes it.

parameters.description: By storage, in the order of the calling convention.

ties.description: The structures the function is tied to: what a parameter or local points at.

via.description: Our name of the parameter or local that points at it.

fingerprint.description: Facts about the code that do not depend on the build, never the code or its text: what finds the function again after a patch (Registry/Fingerprint.cs). Its size and body hash are in each build's table.

calls.description: Sorted: a callee's registry id; fp: and 16 digits of the hash of a callee without one; import: and the hash of an imported name; calls:<n> in a callee's own facts.

strings.description: Hashes of the text constants it loads, sorted.

components.description: The component types whose index it touches, sorted.
